summary: Frontend-only Meta Pixel (1602236614404512) + consent gating + Facebook link testing via Playwright with desktop-Chrome UA override (add_init_script on navigator.userAgent) and interception of facebook.com/tr, googletagmanager.com, clarity.ms, fbevents.js. All 10 requested scenarios pass. Opt-in gating works (0 third-party requests before consent and after Reject). Accept All loads GTM, gtag, Clarity and fbevents, and sends exactly 1 PageView for '/' with no ViewContent. Full loads of /pricing, /contact and /about and SPA navigation to /contact, /tools, /services, /signup each send 1 PageView + 1 ViewContent (content_name/category correct). /legal/privacy and /account send a PageView only. WhatsApp clicks send exactly 1 Lead (contact row: location=contact; floating button: location=general). The contact form sends 1 Lead (source=contact-page), and the lead was persisted (GET /api/admin/leads). Signup sends exactly 1 CompleteRegistration (method=password) and redirects to /account. The disposable account was hard-deleted. Manage → marketing-only loads only the pixel (no GTM/Clarity). Facebook links in the footer, the Contact page and /about are correct with target=_blank. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow.

integration_issues.flow: Full page load /pricing right after consent (1st run)
integration_issues.issue: FLAKY: one run saw 2 ViewContent GET /tr requests for /pricing (same cd) with 1 PageView. Did not reproduce in 7 later full loads of /pricing, /contact and /about (always 1+1). fbq state eventCount=2. Code dedupe (lastPixelPath) looks correct, so the cause is probably a transport retry inside fbevents. Failure rate about 1 in 8 (12%).

fbevents autoConfig is on by default. Every button click (e.g. contact-submit, nav-cta-explore) sends an extra POST /tr with ev=SubscribedButtonClick, and the request carries button text/metadata. These are not duplicates of standard events, but they add noise and send more data. Consider fbq('set','autoConfig',false,PIXEL_ID) before fbq('init').

Events not in META_STANDARD are sent to Meta with trackCustom (e.g. explore_platform_click, ai_referral). This is intended by the code, but it goes beyond the 4 required events. Confirm this is wanted.

issues: The subtitle still reads 'Reach the Vametra AI team on email, WhatsApp or Instagram' and does not mention Facebook (or LinkedIn).

action_items: Consent revocation (GDPR): if a visitor accepts and later switches Marketing off via Cookie Preferences, applyConsent() never unloads or revokes. window.fbq stays live and trackEvent keeps sending Lead/custom events to Meta until a full reload. Use fbq('consent','revoke') / fbq('consent','grant') or guard fbq calls with getConsent().marketing. The same applies to gtag/clarity for analytics.
Optional: disable Meta autoConfig (SubscribedButtonClick auto events).
Optional: update the Contact hero subtitle to include Facebook.

Out of scope, seen during signup: the form default role 'exporter' (CompleteRegistration cd[role]=exporter) but /account showed an 'importer' badge and 'Set country' even though country=India was sent. POST /api/onboarding/register (DO) was called 3 times. Check role/country persistence on register.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics.js: catLoaded flags are only ever set to true. There is no path for withdrawing consent within a session (see action item).
pixelPageView dedupes on pathname only, so query-only changes (/pricing?a -> /pricing?b) give no new PageView. This is acceptable but worth knowing.
trackEvent scrub() works: CompleteRegistration sent only method/role/country, and Lead sent location/page/source. No email, phone or name reached Meta.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested scenarios (10/10); 1 flaky duplicate ViewContent observed once

The browser_automation tool works with page.add_init_script("Object.defineProperty(navigator,'userAgent',{get:()=>'<Chrome UA>'})"). Set consent directly with localStorage ln_cookie_consent={essential,analytics,marketing,ts}.
